This refers to your favorite Cherry Blossom SPOT. You can register up to 30 locations.

• Cherry Blossom Flowering Forecast Map
The pins on the map indicate the locations of Cherry Blossom SPOT all over Japan.
Furthermore, the colors of the pins indicate the growth percentages of the cherry blossoms.
You can call up the route guidance function of your map app from the "Route to this Sakura Spot" button.
If you open Sakura Map outside of Japan, the map will automatically be moved to Japan (Tokyo).
